hack.root_cause: Oracle Price Delta Manipulation (Timing + Network Congestion)
hack.description: Levana Protocol lost $1.1M — 10% of LP liquidity — to a 14-day stealth attack that exploited timing gaps in oracle updates, with the biggest losses coming when a Cosmos network congestion bug (and a DDoS) gave the attacker uninterrupted windows to make loaded leveraged bets.
